# Windows Game Explorer v2.6.0

> Responsive dynamic standalone window sizing, automatic navigation pane suppression, authentic Windows 11 Fluent 3D controller iconography, and multi-drive game discovery.

---

## 📋 Overview

**Windows Game Explorer v2.6.0** delivers fully responsive, dynamic window sizing and resizability for the standalone `shell:games` window, matching the fluid layout behavior of the File Explorer tab experience. The standalone window now incorporates automatic navigation pane and status bar suppression without hardcoded sizes, allowing the XAML Island viewport to seamlessly flow to any user resolution, aspect ratio, or window geometry.

This release also introduces the authentic Windows 11 Fluent 3D game controller icon directly embedded into the shell extension DLL, updates face button iconography to standard physical gamepad colors (Y=Yellow, B=Red, X=Blue, A=Green), and expands game detection to scan multiple drive roots with smart engine and middleware heuristic analysis.

---

## ✨ Highlights

- **Dynamic Standalone Window Sizing** — Pure dynamic layout and resizability (`WS_CAPTION | WS_THICKFRAME | WS_MINIMIZEBOX | WS_MAXIMIZEBOX | WS_SYSMENU`) with fluid XAML Island reflow across all monitor resolutions.
- **Standalone Navigation Pane Suppression** — Automatically suppresses the Left Navigation Pane (`NamespaceTreeControl`) and status bar view switcher in standalone `shell:games` windows while preserving the full navigation pane in File Explorer tab mode.
- **Windows 11 Fluent 3D Controller Icon** — Hand-crafted 3D controller iconography embedded into `GameExplorerShell.dll` (`IDI_GAME_EXPLORER` 100) across 7 resolution layers (16px to 256px) with authentic face button coloring and shadow rendering.
- **Smart Game Engine Detection & Multi-Drive Scanning** — Discovers installed games across all mounted fixed/removable drives with heuristic signatures for Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot, GameMaker, RPG Maker, Ren'Py, Source/GoldSrc, and 16 middleware suites.
- **Storefront-Validated Artwork Pipeline** — Strict aspect-ratio slot filtering (cover 0.45..1.15, hero 1.20..4.50, icon 0.75..1.33) with zero-cropping full-frame scaling and cross-storefront API validation before artwork attachment.

## 🔍 What's Changed

### 🆕 Added
- **Dynamic window sizing architecture** — full window resizability with fluid grid layout across all screen resolutions; 1px size delta trigger in `LibraryViewHost::Resize` guarantees `DesktopWindowContentBridge` receives `WM_SIZE` on layout changes.
- **Standalone navigation pane & status bar suppression** — hides `NamespaceTreeControl` and `msctls_statusbar32` when invoked via `shell:games` or desktop shortcuts while retaining full navigation pane structure in existing Explorer tabs.
- **Windows 11 Fluent 3D game controller icon** — custom Fluent 3D icon in `src/shell/Resource.ico` and `assets/game-explorer-icon.ico` with standardized button colors (Y=Yellow, B=Red, X=Blue, A=Green).
- **Smart Game Engine & Multi-Drive Heuristics** — indexes common game directories and verifies executable engines (Unity, Unreal, Godot, Source, etc.) across all mounted storage devices.
- **Storefront artwork validation** — cross-validates titles with official Steam Store, GOG, itch.io, and VNDB APIs before metadata ingestion.
- **Aspect-ratio slot filtering & zero-cropping** — cards scale artwork cleanly with `Stretch::Fill` without edge cropping or letterbox distortion.

### 🔄 Changed
- Corrected `GOVERNANCE.md` to reflect true maintainer governance and AI-assisted workflow.
- Updated NSIS installer minimum version check to Windows 11 (Build 22000+) following Windows 10 end-of-life.
- Canonical sorting order index set to `0x41` (65) placing Games after Home and Gallery.

### 🐛 Fixed
- Fixed standalone XAML island layout stalling at initial parent dimensions by ensuring size change notifications are processed synchronously.
- Fixed face button color inversion on 3D controller icon assets.
- Fixed multiple desktop and start menu shortcut creation conflicts during shell registration.
